snippet.title: Nioh 3 - Bloody Insurrection DLC Vol. 2 First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://teamninja-studio.com/nioh3/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=USDLC2&utm_id=Caption

Bloody Insurrection brings the story of Nioh 3 to its conclusion as the final add-on DLC, and introduces the exclusive endgame content "Battlefield of Carnage". Arriving this December 17, 2026 for PlayStation®5 and Steam®, this teaser trailer offers a first look into the final chapter of Nioh 3.

■ Official X Account (Nioh Official)
https://x.com/nioh_game
